title: Coherent realization of inner anodyne maps
statement: Use simplicial sets, standard simplices, horns and weak homotopy equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the subset-poset coherent realization $\mathfrak C$ of [lem-coef-pinched-cube-latching]. An inner anodyne map is a member of the smallest class containing all isomorphisms and $\Lambda_i^n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$ for $n\geq2$, $0<i<n$, and closed under arbitrary pushouts, small continuous transfinite compositions and arrow retracts. A simplicial functor is a Dwyer--Kan equivalence if it induces weak homotopy equivalences on every mapping simplicial set and an equivalence of categories after taking path components of mapping simplicial sets. For every inner anodyne map $u:A\to B$ of small simplicial sets, $\mathfrak C[u]$ is a Dwyer--Kan equivalence. There is no quasicategory hypothesis on $A$ or $B$.
